company_name: Safe Bulkers Inc Common Stock ($0.001 par value)
title: Announcement Of Major Holdings According To Law 3556/2007
body_markdown:
Safe Bulkers, Inc. (the **"Company"** ), following receipt of relevant notifications on 14.09.2026 from Chalkoessa Maritime Inc. and Mr. Polys Hajioannou, announces in accordance with Law 3556/2007, that on 11 September 2026 (date of admission of 12,000,000 new common stock shares issued in the context of the Company’s share capital increase (the *“Share Capital Increase”* ) to parallel listing for trading on the Main Market of the Regulated Securities Market of Euronext Athens), the following changes to its voting rights occurred:


- Due to non-participation of Chalkoessa Maritime Inc. in the Share Capital Increase, the percentage of voting rights corresponding to its 5,400,000 common stock shares in the Company was reduced to **4.74%** . In accordance with the immediately previous notification received, Chalkoessa Maritime Inc. directly held 5,400,000 common stock shares and voting rights in the Company, corresponding to **5.30%** of the total voting rights in the Company.
- Mr. Polys Hajioannou indirectly – through “Moutoulas Shipping Corporation”, an entity controlled by him – acquired 1,500,000 new common stock shares and voting rights in the Company. As a result, the percentage of voting rights indirectly held by Mr. Polys Hajioannou in the Company, through the entities listed below, was reduced to **43.82%** of the Company’s total voting rights, corresponding to **49,881,427** common stock shares issued by the Company:


No. Corporate name* Number of Common Stock Shares and voting rights Percentage of total voting rights


1. Vorini Holdings Inc. 19,426,015 17.07%


2. Bellapais Maritime Inc. 5,000,000 4.39%


3. Kyperounta Maritime Inc. 5,000,000 4.39%


4. Lefkoniko Maritime Inc. 5,000,000 4.39%


5. Akamas Maritime Inc. 8,555,412 7.52%


6. Chalkoessa Maritime Inc. 5,400,000 4.74%


7. Moutoulas Shipping Corporation 1,500,000 1.32%


* All entities are controlled by Mr. Polys Hajioannou.


Monaco, 15 September 2026


SAFE BULKERS, INC.
